notes.title: 02.07.2024 Update Notes
notes.content:
[Added] Shout Speed Multiplier server option
[Added] Shout Decibel Multiplier server option
[Added] Create Game Panel to prevent wrong lobby type selection
[Added] Server options shortcut to party screen
[Added] Inventory now accessible in party screen
[Added] New info texts to make game more understandable

[Changed] Now shout does not silenced for 1 second at first exit
[Changed] Now big objects are have less friction
[Changed] Public/Private lobby toggle is now more understandable

[Fixed] Lobbies sometimes can joinable by everyone when setted private
[Fixed] Waiting for server to restart info shown always on clients
[Fixed] Trapped sound fx not played on other players
[Fixed] Player volumes sometimes does not work as intended
[Fixed] Steam Friends can join password protected lobbies without asking for password
[Fixed] In stage 2 big rocks are can climbable
